core.carousel.admin_help: Carousels show news (pages published “as news”), own slides and items of external RSS/Atom feeds at a position of the template.
core.carousel.name: Name
core.carousel.name_help: Read out by screen readers as the name of the carousel.
core.carousel.autoplay_help: 0 = off (recommended). 3 to 60 seconds; a pause button is shown, rotation stops on hover and focus and when the visitor prefers reduced motion.
core.carousel.feeds_help: One address per line. Fetched every 10 minutes.
core.carousel.image_alt_help: Describes the image for people who cannot see it (required with an image).
core.carousel.news_help: News “{title}”: the page is shown with its title, beginning and preview image. Here you can change the period.
core.carousel.delete_confirm: Delete the carousel “{name}” with all its slides?
core.carousel.allow_private_help: Only for feeds in your own network (e.g. an intranet server). Off by default for security reasons.
core.carousel.news_until_help: Empty: until removed in the administration.
perm.core.carousel.manage_help: Create carousels, place them, edit slides and external feeds.
perm.core.carousel.publish_help: Show a published page as news in a carousel (option when publishing).
core.carousel.sources_help: The newest elements of these sources become slides (title, summary, preview image). Only elements the viewer may read are shown.
core.carousel.feed_items_help: Per feed, and for all sources together.
